sections.title: Estate Documents at Home
sections.subtitle: Valley Notary Services
sections.narration: Sensitive documents deserve privacy — not a crowded UPS store. When your family needs wills, trusts, or healthcare directives notarized, Valley Notary Services comes to your home or your attorney's office in Modesto and Stanislaus County.
sections.caption: Private signing at home

sections.title: When Families Call
sections.subtitle: Hospitals · Evenings · Multiple signers
sections.narration: Families call us when an attorney sends estate planning documents, when a parent is in the hospital, or when multiple family members need to sign at the kitchen table after work. You need a calm, professional notary who respects the moment — not a rushed storefront line.
sections.caption: Calm, professional presence

sections.title: What We Notarize
sections.subtitle: Not legal advice — notarial acts only
sections.narration: We notarize wills, trusts, healthcare directives, powers of attorney, and related acknowledgments. We are not attorneys and cannot give legal advice. We perform notarial acts only — making the signing process smooth, clear, and compliant with California law.
sections.caption: Wills · Trusts · Healthcare directives · POA

sections.title: Before We Arrive
sections.subtitle: Simple preparation
sections.narration: Have valid photo ID for every signer. Bring unsigned documents unless your attorney directed otherwise. Confirm who must be present — we'll follow any special instructions from your attorney. We'll bring the notarial supplies.
sections.caption: ID · Unsigned docs · All signers present

sections.title: Book a Family Appointment
sections.subtitle: info@valleynotaryservices.com
sections.narration: Email info at valleynotaryservices.com with subject line Notary Appointment Request. Tell us the document type, preferred date and time, and location in Modesto or nearby. Valley Notary Services — mobile notary for estate and family documents in the Central Valley.
